content: ![替代文字](https://imgur.com/sWhGgHc.png) # Hopo 更優礦坑「15種礦坑類型」# [![Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/hopo-better-mineshaft?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth)](https://modrinth.com/datapack/hopo-better-mineshaft) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/949138580415062017?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord)](https://discord.gg/CZQthZJjPc) **💎 礦坑已透過此資料包獲得改善，還有更多內容等你探索，敬請享受！** ✨ 原版礦坑已經很不錯了，所以我並未更動它們，而是新增了全新的礦坑類型。前往深板岩層探索，準備迎接全新的地下挑戰吧。 🧨 新增了許多主題房間，讓你總有新鮮事物可看，永不無聊。 🎨 超過10種礦坑類型，每種都有獨特之處，有的礦石含量更高，有的甚至會生成怪物…… ![替代文字](https://imgur.com/LQXHEUd.png) ![替代文字](https://imgur.com/DycIqbn.png) ![替代文字](https://imgur.com/1gTe61a.png) ### 如果你想展開冒險，結帳時使用優惠碼 'HOPONO' 即可享首月75折優惠！❤️ ### https://bisecthosting.com/hopono [![Discord](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/social/discord-plural_64h.png)](https://discord.gg/CZQthZJjPc) [![CurseForge](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/available/curseforge_64h.png)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/hopo-better-mineshaft) [](https://modrinth.com/datapack/hopo-better-mineshaft) [](https://ko-fi.com/hoponopono) ![替代文字](https://imgur.com/lNhcvC4.png)
